title: Chromatic Gear
summary: **Chromatic Gear** is the SMP's custom armour, tools and weapons. Build it at `/craft` or win it from the Chroma Crate, and keep it when you die.

blocks.p: Build a piece at the Chromatic bench with `/craft`, or win it from the [Chroma Crate](/wiki/smp/crates/). The mace, spear and elytra have no recipe and only come from the crate. Recipe costs are on [Crafting and Upgrades](/wiki/smp/crafting/).

ul: {{icon:chromatic_chestplate}} Armour: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots. Wear all four for the set bonus.
{{icon:chromatic_sword}} Weapons: sword, spear, mace, bow and crossbow.
{{icon:chromatic_pickaxe}} Tools: pickaxe, axe, shovel, harvester and angler.

blocks.p: A new piece comes with these enchants. The bonus is the ability its lore describes.

Chromatic gear stays with you when you die (see [Keep-on-Death Gear](/wiki/smp/keep-on-death/)). When its durability runs out it does not break. It turns into a Shattered item that keeps its enchants, upgrades, prefix and StatTrak, and `/craft repair` brings it back.
The armour has gem sockets: see [Amethyst Gems](/wiki/gear/gems/).

ul: Upgrade enchants past their starting level at the Upgrade bench in `/craft`.
A Chromatic piece is what you upgrade into its [Living Prism](/wiki/gear/living-prism/) twin. Its upgrades, Awakening, prefix and enchants carry over, except Thorns.
Salvaging a piece you no longer need gives Prism Shards back.

history.text: The Chromatic set bonus is now Strength I instead of Resistance I.
Chromatic and Halloween gear no longer breaks: at 0 durability it turns Shattered and keeps its enchants until you repair it with `/craft repair`.
Added the Chromatic Harvester, which reaps and replants a 3x3 of crops, and the Chromatic Angler, which lands a double catch every 15 seconds.
